question: calculate 2023 rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: SELECT a.district, (100.0 * a.children_fully_immunised / NULLIF(a.children_due, 0)) - (100.0 * b.children_fully_immunised / NULLIF(b.children_due, 0)) AS rate_change_pp FROM immunisation AS a JOIN immunisation AS b ON a.district = b.district WHERE a.year = 2023 AND b.year = 2021 AND a.district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')

```sql
SELECT
  a.district,
  (100.0 * a.children_fully_immunised / a.children_due)
  - (100.0 * b.children_fully_immunised / b.children_due) AS rate_change_pp
FROM immunisation a
JOIN immunisation b
  ON a.district = b.district
WHERE a.year = 2023
  AND b.year = 2021
  AND a.district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda');
```
